vertices.purpose: Installs or refreshes the project-local Maestro runtime: copies changed scripts into .claude/scripts, renders the orchestrator skill, updates settings.json hooks and the channel allow rule, seeds maestro.json on first install, stamps runtimeVersion and syncs reports and handoffs, then returns an install report. Refuses before writing if maestro.json is not a parseable v3 config.
inputs: reportsDbPath, projectTagsDbPath, handoffsDbPath: optional store locations
outputs: InstallReport: scripts written, hooks added/removed, permissions added, config seeded, runtimeVersion, sync results, warnings and post-install status
vertices.sig_seen: function installRuntime(projectRoot: string, pluginRoot?: string, reportsDbPath?: string, projectTagsDbPath?: string, handoffsDbPath?: string): Promise<InstallReport>

vertices.purpose: Compares two filesystem paths after resolving symlinks on both sides, so the same directory reached through different spellings (e.g. /tmp vs /private/tmp) counts as equal.
outputs: true when both paths resolve to the same real location, false otherwise
vertices.sig_seen: function samePath(a: string, b: string): boolean

vertices.purpose: Computes the hex SHA-256 digest of a string or buffer; used to compare file content (never mtime) between the shipped and installed copies.
Returns the plugin root directory, falling back to the default location, and throws a user-facing error telling the caller to set MAESTRO_PLUGIN_ROOT when none can be found.
outputs: the resolved plugin root path (throws when none exists)

vertices.purpose: Parses a version string of the form X.Y.Z with an optional prerelease tag into its numeric core and prerelease parts, rejecting anything else.
inputs: v: value of unknown type expected to be a version string
outputs: { core: [major, minor, patch], pre } or null when the input is not a valid version

vertices.purpose: Reports whether a project's Maestro install is present, missing pieces, or stale: compares installed scripts and orchestrator skill against the shipped plugin, checks registered hooks, and detects a project stamped newer than the app (appBehind).
outputs: InstallStatus: installed flag, missing/out-of-date scripts, hooks registered/missing, runtime digests, stale flag, appBehind notice
vertices.sig_seen: function installStatus(projectRoot: string, pluginRoot?: string): Promise<InstallStatus>

vertices.purpose: Reads the plugin.json version the app ships; this is the value a fresh install or refresh stamps into a project's maestro.json as runtimeVersion.
outputs: the version string from .claude-plugin/plugin.json (throws if missing)

vertices.purpose: Names the eight Claude Code hook events the install can register.
outputs: string union of hook event names

vertices.purpose: Creates a directory (and its parents) if it does not already exist.
Returns the path of the project's rendered orchestrator skill, .claude/skills/maestro/SKILL.md.
outputs: absolute path to the orchestrator SKILL.md

vertices.purpose: Joins a project-relative destination path written with forward slashes onto the project root using the platform separator.
vertices.sig_seen: function projectPath(projectRoot: string, dest: string): string

vertices.purpose: Decides whether a plugin-side copy of a hook script should stand down because the project registers the same hook in its own .claude settings files; the project's own copy never yields.
inputs: cwd: project root from the hook payload
event: optional hook_event_name to limit the check
outputs: true if the project's settings.json or settings.local.json registers this script's twin for the event(s), else false
vertices.sig_seen: function projectOwnsHook(scriptPath: string, cwd: string, event?: string): boolean
